6-DAY PHYSIQUE
TRANSFORMATION SPLIT

DAY 1
CHEST + TRICEPS
Bench Press 3 x 8-12
Incline DB Press 3 x 10
Chest Fly 3 x 12
Tricep Pushdown 3 x 12
OH Tricep Extension 3 x 10
Push-ups 2 sets

DAY 2
BACK + BICEPS
Lat Pulldown 3 x 10
Seated Cable Row 3 x 10
One-arm DB Row 3 x 10
Barbell Curl 3 x 12
Hammer Curl 3 x 12
Dead Hang 2 sets

DAY 3
LEGS
Squats 4 x 8
Leg Press 3 x 10
Leg Curl 3 x 12
Leg Extension 3 x 12
Calf Raises 4 x 15

DAY 4
SHOULDERS + ABS
Shoulder Press 3 x 10
Lateral Raises 3 x 12
Front Raises 3 x 12
Shrugs 3 x 15
Crunches 3 x 20
Leg Raises 3 x 15
Plank 3 x 30 sec

DAY 5
CHEST + BACK
Incline Bench Press 3 x 10
Lat Pulldown 3 x 10
Dumbbell Press 3 x 10
Cable Row 3 x 10
Push-ups 2 sets

DAY 6
ARMS + ABS
Barbell Curl 3 x 10
Hammer Curl 3 x 12
Tricep Dips 3 x 10
Rope Pushdown 3 x 12
Russian Twists 3 x 20
Plank 3 x 45 sec

DAY 7
REST DAY
WALKING OR CYCLING
STRETCHING
STAY
SLEEP
